# nlohmann/json 3.12.0

Unmodified upstream single-header release: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`.

The MIT license and copyright notice are retained inside `json.hpp`. Native builds verify this file locally with `scripts/prepare-native-key-crypto.mjs`; they never fetch it. When updating, replace the header from a reviewed upstream release and update the pinned checksum in the same change.
